app.name: Thai Government Jobs
app.tagline: Search government job announcements, save the ones you want, and get an email the moment a matching position opens.
app.description: Public Thai government job announcements from OCSC — search, filter, save, and set up email alerts.

alertForm.name: Alert name
alertForm.keywordsHint: Matched as substrings against the position title and agency name — "นักวิชาการคอมพิวเตอร์" matches "นักวิชาการคอมพิวเตอร์ปฏิบัติการ". Any one keyword matching is enough.

alertForm.criteriaRequired: Add at least one criterion, or the alert would match every announcement
